page.notes: Greek passages are uncertain in several letters (e.g. the opening Greek word of the second paragraph, the verse stanza and the Clemens quotation); the Greek is transcribed as read, but without certainty and should be checked against the scan. The Greek parenthesis at the opening of the second paragraph is marked as a whole for the same reason. The Greek of the Sotades stanza has its first line partly illegible. "conscreare" is read from the print; the scan's letters are close to "conscreare" and may be a printing variant. The catchword "Ad" is at the foot right.
